title: Atlas · Wed Nov 18 · 6:45am
big_picture: Taylor, the market fell on Tuesday (SPY -1.0%, 48% of large caps above their 50-day) and futures are pointing up this morning on Nvidia. Nvidia reported fiscal Q3 after the close: revenue $115.8B (+103% from a year ago), EPS $2.68 against about $2.48 expected, a Q4 revenue guide of about $130B, and a gross margin guide of 71-72% against 74.9% in Q3 ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/17/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q3-2027.html), [Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/premarket-movers-nvidia-jumps-on-strong-ai-outlook-lowes-falls-5035719)). Premarket NVDA is up roughly 3-4% from $155.46-156.14, depending on the source and the minute, so the real answer is the 7:30am open. Anthropic prices tonight (range $70-78) and trades Thursday; the Fed minutes are also due today ([TradingKey](https://www.tradingkey.com/analysis/stocks/us-stocks/262311015-us-pre-market-nvda-anthropic-tradingkey)).

sectors.why: Tuesday was a wait for Nvidia. The numbers beat; the open decides whether the market cares. Two things in the report are not clean: the margin guide (71-72%, Rubin ramp and memory costs; the report is a fact, the reason is the company's and a news summary's) and receivables, which grew faster than sales. What would change the view: MU closing under $650, SMH under its Nov 5 low, or a gap up that fades in the first hour. Wait 15-30 minutes after the 7:30am open.

- Nvidia call (t20261117-3): answered. Management said its neocloud commitments ($32B) take effect only if the customer secures financing and the capacity is deployed and accepted; guarantees total $118B, including $105B of credit support for the PORTS-Pike campus, with no payments made so far. The written commentary said some commitments "could be reduced or eliminated" if neoclouds overextend, and Kress said Nvidia is "rigorously evaluating future investments, commitments, and guarantees". These come from news summaries of the call, not the transcript or 10-Q ([TheStreet](https://www.thestreet.com/latest-news/nvda-nvidia-corporation-q3-2027-earnings-stock-updates), [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/17/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q3-2027.html)). It speaks to your money-trail question: the company itself describes the exposure as large and conditional.

- Anthropic IPO (t20261114-3): still open. Range $70-78 unchanged in the Tuesday filing; CNBC and Bloomberg sources say it will likely price above the range (anonymous-source reports, a rumour until priced) ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/17/anthropic-ipo-price.html)).

- DRAM prices (t20261114-4): still open. TrendForce's Q4 2026 forecast is contract prices up 10-15% quarter on quarter, slower than Q3; I found no December-specific price, and the pages are mostly second-hand ([COINOTAG on TrendForce](https://en.coinotag.com/trendforce-2026-q4-dram-contract-prices-up-10-15)). Rising, but slowing, is the cycle-peak worry in a sentence.

Trend board changes: AI build-out stays "fading" (set last night). New evidence: Nvidia's beat and $130B guide, the conditional-commitment wording, and Anthropic's likely above-range pricing (rumour). Nothing closes it: MU is above $650 and SMH has not made a new low. Today's open and tonight's Anthropic pricing are the next tests.
Your lessons: none tested this morning. L6 (NVDA report, perception over numbers) waits for the next-day and one-week moves of NVDA, SMH and MU; the first read is today's close.
